Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie will open the batting for Ireland. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... The Chase ...

Ireland got off to a perfect start! They got rid off Ishan Kishan in the third over and put themselves ahead early in the game. But post that they had no answers to the power-hitting displayed by Deepak Hooda and Sanju Samson. All the bowlers were taken to the cleaners! Every ball was being dispatched into the crowd. However, once they broke that mammoth partnership, they grabbed wickets at regular intervals from there. They did well to towards the end but still have a mountain to climb. Amidst all the carnage, Mark Adair grabbed three wickets, while Josh Little and Craig Young picked up two wickets. The batters face a challenge ahead. Can they do so? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

A good decision to bat first by Hardik Pandya! This full Indian innings though belonged only to two people, Sanju Samson and Deepak Hooda. Both of them have grabbed their opportunities beautifully. Samson on his return to the side scored a sublime 77 and Hooda who was asked to bat at number 3 notched up an exceptional century. Deepak Hooda became the only fourth Indian to get a ton in T20Is! The duo stitched together a partnership of 176 runs and guided India to a total of 189 in the 17th over! Once, Samson perished, wickets fell in a heap! All of a sudden from 189 for 1 India were reduced to 224 for 7! They would be disappointed with that finish but will definitely be the happier side!

Another day, another match, and it's been another stupendous batting performance from India. It was absolute carnage out there! Power-hitting at its very best! India have posted a monstrous total of on the board! A tough, tough task for Ireland ahead. Although they have done well to pull this back towards the fag end, things could have been a lot worse.

Just a single to end the innings! A very full delivery, on off. Bhuvneshwar Kumar forces it to long off. Andy Balbirnie there fumbles but the batters settle for a single. India finish with massive 225/7 after 20 overs!
Bhuvneshwar Kumar walks in to face the final ball.

OUT! BOWLED! Ireland have done well in these last few overs! Harshal Patel gets across a bit early towards the off side and Adair delivers a yorker on off. Patel looks to scoop it but misses. The ball shatters the middle pole and India lose another wicket. Mark Adair gets his third wicket!
This is full and outside off. Pandya hits it hard towards sweeper cover and the fielder again does well in the deep. Just a single.
FOUR! Helicopter shot from Pandya! This is very full again on off. Pandya gets across and goes deep in his crease to whip it away towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A very full ball on off. Pandya drills it straight down the ground and comes back for the second run.
This is full and outside off. Pandya hits it towards deep extra-cover. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and does well to keep it inside the fence. No run taken there!
Harshal Patel walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Craig Young gets two in two and Axar Patel goes for a golden duck! This is full on middle. Patel flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket and George Dockrell there moves swiftly towards his left to takes a good low catch. Actually, Axar Patel times it well but unfortunately for him, he finds the fielder.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Axar Patel is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another wicket for Ireland! This has been a good over from Young and he is rewarded with a big wicket. Lands on a length, around off. Dinesh Karthik looks to push at it. However, the ball just seams away a bit and catches the outside edge of Karthik's blade. The ball goes to the keeper and Lorcan Tucker takes an easy catch. Dinesh Karthik knows he is out and starts walking immediately.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on off. Pandya mistimes his pull shot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good yorker outside off. Pandya looks to dig it out but misses.
FOUR! Hardik Pandya gets the boundary this time! It is full on middle. Pandya flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
This is full and outside off. Pandya looks to drive it away but misses.
Dinesh Karthik is the new man in. Also, Craig Young comes to bowl his final over!

OUT! CAUGHT! Hooda holes out and finally Ireland manages to dismiss him in this series! End of a fantastic knock from this powerful lad and he has taken his team to a very big total here! This is full and outside off. Hooda slices it aerially towards the third man region and Andy McBrine running to his left takes a good sliding catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This is easy pickings for Hooda! Short and angling into the body. Hooda pulls it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Pandya works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off. Pandya tries to cut it but misses.
Hardik Pandya, the skipper of India comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Suryakumar Yadav departs now, trying to manufacture another cute shot here but fails to execute it. Little comes 'round the wicket and angles a shortish delivery around leg. Yadav gets across and looks to paddle it. However, he gets a faint part of his blade and Lorcan Tucker takes a good catch moving to his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length, around off. Yadav just late cuts it over short third man for a boundary.

That's it. Century for Deepak Hooda! What an innings! Exceptional hitting, six sixes from Hooda so far! Back of a length, on off. Hooda just pushes it towards point and takes a single. Takes off his helmet and soaks in the applause from a loud crowd here at Malahide.

FOUR! Misfield and this is the last thing Ireland need at the moment! This is fuller on off. Yadav makes a bit of room and drives it to the extra-cover fielder in the ring. Paul Stirling misfields as the ball goes through him for a boundary.

SIX! There is that shot, SKY played when he faced the first ball in Indian colours! A short ball on middle. Suryakumar Yadav gets a bit across and plays that trademark helicopter pull of his over deep backward square leg for a maximum.
This is full and outside off. Hooda drives it to right of mid off and takes a single Moves onto 99 now!
A full delivery on the pads. Yadav clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Suryakumar Yadav walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! BOWLED! Ohh...what a comeback from Mark Adair! Bowls a terrific slower yorker! He does that from 'round the wicket on middle. Samson is early on his shot and gets foxed completely. The ball knocks over the stumps and that's an end of a brilliant knock from Sanju Samson in his comeback game.
SIX! Gift from Mark Adair and Sanju Samson says, Thank you very much! A full toss on the hips. Samson just guides it over the fine leg fence for a maximum.
Mark Adair comes back to bowl.
Dot to end the over! A slower length ball, on off. Hooda pushes it back to the bowler. Good over from Young. just 6 from it!  Hooda stays on 98!
Back of a length, on middle. Samson works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Just a single! A full delivery, around off. Hooda hits it quite well down the ground but settles for a single.
On a length, on off. Samson pushes it gently towards covers for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Hooda works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Young goes a tad short on off. Hooda makes room and cuts it to deep point. They run single and there is a bit of hesitation in taking the second run but they make it easily in the end.
SIX! Back-to-back sixes for Sanju Samson! Short on this occasion, around the leg pole. Sanju Samson gets his front leg out of the way and dispatches this one over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
SIX! KABOOM! Full, around middle. Sanju Samson tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Outside off, fullish ball. Deepak Hooda pushes it down to long off for a single.
Short, on middle. Sanju Samson pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! BYES! Shorter ball, outside off. Sanju Samson looks to heave this but he misses as the ball stays low. Lorcan Tucker fails to grab the ball as well. It races away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller delivery on off. Hooda drives it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On the pads fuller ball. Sanju Samson uses his wrists and flicks it to deep square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off. Samson looks to get hit bat on it but misses.
On a length, around off. Deepak Hooda drives it to long off for a single.
A beauty! This one nips back in from a length ball, around off. Deepak Hooda looks to cut this over but he gets beaten on the inside edge.
FOUR! Crunched! A length ball, outside off. Deepak Hooda hits this inside-out over cover for a boundary. Into the 90s now!

Caught off the Free Hit! A length ball, around middle. Sanju Samson looks to flick this but he gets a leading edge towards backward point. Josh Little catches the ball at backward point and collides with another fielder who was running for the catch as well. Single taken!
No ball! Fuller one, around off. Deepak Hooda drives it towards long on for a single. Oh, dear! Conor Olphert has overstepped here! No ball is called and Free Hit is coming up.
SIX! Deepak Hooda moves onto 86 off 43 balls with that hit! Shorter one, on the body. Deepak Hooda dispatches this one high over deep square leg and into the stands for a biggie.
Wide! Conor Olphert errs in line and bowls it down the leg side. Deepak Hooda leaves it alone. Wide called!
Conor Olphert will continue.
Loopy one, around middle. Deepak Hooda advances down the track and knocks it to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Sanju Samson drives it towards cover for a single.

FOUR! Sanju Samson brings up his maiden T20I fifty in style! Shorter one, around middle. Sanju Samson swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary. A fifty on his return to the Indian side. He has grabbed his opportunity with both hands.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Deepak Hooda knocks it down to long off for a single.
A rare dot ball! Too full, outside off. Deepak Hooda leaves it alone.
Fuller one, tosses this one up, around middle. Deepak Hooda dances down the wicket and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Gareth Delany is back on.
On the pads now, fuller ball. Deepak Hooda flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Deepak Hooda is making batting look so easy at the moment! A fuller ball, outside off. Deepak Hooda slices this one high over over cover for a boundary.
Wide! Wide of off, fuller ball. Deepak Hooda looks to slash this but he misses. Wide callled! Conor Olphert does not look happy with that. It did look well inside though.
Fuller ball, around middle. Deepak Hooda flicks it wide of long on. They run the first one and a little fumble by the fielder there allows the batters to take another run as well!
Outside off, length delivery. Deepak Hooda cuts it and finds the fielder at point.
SIX! Bang! This is bigger and better! Shorter, around middle. Deepak Hooda pulls it high over deep square leg for a biggie.

FOUR! Up and over! Overpitched delivery this one, around middle and off. Deepak Hooda lifts it over the fielder at mid off. The ball goes a couple of bounces over the ropes for a boundary. That brings up the 100-run partnership between these two!
Wide! Conor Olphert errs in line, he serves it way down the leg side. Deepak Hooda leaves it alone. Wide called!

FOUR! Through the gap again! It's Sanju Samson this time. Shorter ball, wide of off. Sanju Samson rocks back and cuts it in the gap between point and short third man for a boundary. 13 runs off the over!
Pitched up again, outside off. Deepak Hooda strokes it down to long off for a single.
Width on offer, fullish ball. Deepak Hooda slices it towards the fielder at point.
On a length, attacking the stumps this time. Deepak Hooda pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Oh, nicely done yet again! On a length, outside off. Deepak Hooda stays in his crease, opens the face of the bat, and guides it towards third man for a beautiful boundary. Effortlessly done!

FOUR! Deepak Hooda is on fire at the moment! Excellent shot once again! A shorter ball, outside off. Deepak Hooda steps down the wicket and drives it on the up between mid off and extra cover for a boundary.
FIFTY for Deepak Hooda! His first for India in T20Is and he is just going from strength to strength here! On the shorter side on middle. Hooda works it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.

SIX! Andy McBrine was expensive in the only over he bowled in the first game and he is taken to cleaners yet again today! This is fuller on middle. Hooda dances down the track and lifts it over long on for a maximum.
Keeps it flatter on middle. Samson works it to long on for a single.
Flatter now and shorter. Hooda works it to mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! 93 metres hit that! Andy McBrine bowls it full on off. Hooda gets under it and lauches it out of the ground over the mid-wicket fence.
On middle and fuller. Samson works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Andy McBrine comes to bowl now.
Fuller on leg. Samson pushes it to long on for a single.
SIX! Sanju Samson with a biggie now! Short on middle. Samson rocks back and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum.
FOUR! Thick outside edge but another boundary for India and Samson! Short and wide outside off. Samson cuts but gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs way past short third man for a boundary.
A flatter delivery on off. Hooda pushes it down the ground for a single as he steps out to this ball.
WIDE! Fired quicker and down the leg side. Hooda looks to clip it but misses.

Another tough chance goes down! Delany bowls it fuller on off again. Samson hits it hard back to the bowler. He puts his right hand towards the ball to catch it but it does not stick and a single is taken.
A tossed up delivery on off. Hooda drills it to long off for a single.

Dropped! Short and wide outside off. Hooda cuts it firmly towards covers. Paul Stirling with an incredible full-stretch dive to his left. He gets a hand on it. However, the ball does not stick and a single is taken.
FOUR! Ohh..that is glorious! Brings up the fifty partnership between these two! Lands on a length, on middle. Hooda makes room and lifts it with a straight balde over mid off for a boundary.
This is full on the pads. Samson flicks it fine leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Hooda cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Well bowled! In the blockhole on this occasion, around off. Deepak Hooda does well to dig this one out.
Tight single! Conor Olphert starts off with a fuller ball, outside off. Sanju Samson drives towards mid off and scampers across to the other end. He dives in to make his ground!
Conor Olphert is brought into the attack.
Samson skips down the track and drives this fraction short delivery to long off for a single.
Slightly shorter on off. Samson punches it to covers again.
Delany is firing them here at a tight line. This is on off and Samson just pushes it to covers.
Pushes it quicker again on off. Hooda drives it to long off for another single.
Tossed up on middle. Samson knocks it down to long on for a single.
A flatter one on off. Hooda pushes it to long off for a single.
It's time for some spin! Gareth Delany comes into the attack.

FOUR! This is Samson at his best! Lands on a length, around off. Samson waits for it. Opens the face of his blade at the last moment and guides it through the backward point region for a boundary. India are 54/1 after the Powerplay!
A fullish delivery on off. Samson drives but straight back to the bowler.
Pulls his length back and corrects his line as well. On off and Samson pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Samson! Young drifts on the pads. Samson just flicks it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Hooda works it towards the leg side for a single.
SIX! Ohh...down the ground...what a shot this is! A fullish delivery on middle. Hooda dances down the track and lauches it straight down the ground for a biggie.

Direct hit...but Deepak Hooda is safe! Fuller ball, width on offer. Sanju Samson pushes it towards mid off and leaves his crease for a single. Deepak Hooda too sets off for a single, but Sanju Samson sends him in time. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end, but Deepak Hooda was well in.
A length ball, swinging back in, outside off. Deepak Hooda steers it towards deep point for a single.
FOUR! Gorgeous! This time from Deepak Hooda! Pitched up ball, around off. Deepak Hooda shows the full face of the bat and drives it away from mid off for a boundary.

Good-length delivery, around the leg pole. Deepak Hooda looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Deepak Hooda opts for a review immediately! No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that was pitching outside leg. The on-field decision has to be overturned! Heartbreak for Ireland as Deepak Hooda survives!
FOUR! Lovely shot! A length ball, outside off. Deepak Hooda stays in his crease and lifts it over cover for a boundary.
Pitched up delivery, outside off. Deepak Hooda drives this and finds the fielder at mid off.
Josh Little is back on. So just a change of ends for the left-arm seamer. Let's see how this over pans out!
A length ball, outside off. Deepak Hooda taps it towards cover and takes a single. He retains the strike!
Fuller now, around middle. Deepak Hooda pushes it towards mid on.
A length delivery, around middle and leg, Sanju Samson clips it past mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Sanju Samson blocks it off the back foot.
FOUR! Oh, glorious! That had class written all over it! Full, around off. Sanju Samson presents the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
On a length, around middle. Deepak Hooda tries to flick this but the ball goes off the leading edge and towards the vacant mid on region for a single.
No ball! Length ball, angling in, on the pads. Sanju Samson works it away through mid-wicket for a single. Craig Young has overstepped here and a no ball is called! Deepak Hooda to face the Free Hit!
Will Josh Little continue? No, it's the man who is playing his 50th T20I for Ireland today, Craig Young comes onto bowl.
SIX! BANG! A six ruins a good over from Mark Adair! Lovely shot though! Too short, around the leg pole. Deepak Hooda pulls this high over deep square leg for a biggie.
Another full-length delivery, again attacking the stumps. Deepak Hooda flicks past mid-wicket. Craig Young chases the ball, slides, and keeps it to two runs.
Full again, on the stumps. Deepak Hooda flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Pitches it up again, around the off pole now. This time Deepak Hooda blocks it towards mid off.
Fuller ball, around middle. Deepak Hooda presents the full face of the bat and pushes it towards mid on.
Deepak Hooda walks out at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! An early breakthrough for Ireland! This is just what they needed! Mark Adair draws first blood as he gets rid of the dangerous, Ishan Kishan. A shortish ball, wide of off. Ishan Kishan dances down the track and looks to pull this over mid-wicket. But he manages to get only an outside edge back to the keeper. Lorcan Tucker takes an easy catch!
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Angling in, on a length and on the pads. Sanju Samson looks to flick this but he gets a slight inside edge back onto the pads.
Tad shorter, around middle. Sanju Samson taps it towards mid-wicket. No run there!
FOUR! Top shot! Short ball, outside off, at around 147 clicks. Sanju Samson pulls this wide of mid on and towards the fence for a boundary.
Outside off, fullish ball. Sanju Samson drives and finds the fielder at cover-point.
Good line from Josh Little! Cramping the batter for room there! A short ball, around the off pole. Sanju Samson dabs it towards point. No single there!
Josh Little to start from the other end.
Josh Little begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan gets on his toes and taps it towards cover for a quick single.
On the pads, good-length delivery. Ishan Kishan taps it towards square leg and takes a single. He retains the strike! Good start for India! 8 runs off the first over.
Tighter line now! Tad fuller, around the off pole. Ishan Kishan leans forward and defends it out.
This one angles in, on the pads, a length delivery. Sanju Samson tucks it through square leg for another run.
Back of a length, outside off. Ishan Kishan stands tall and pushes it through cover for a single. Ishan Kishan gets off the mark straightaway!
Much fuller now, darting it on the pads. Sanju Samson flicks it through square leg and takes a single.

FOUR! Sanju Samson and India are up and running! This is a good start from Sanju Samson! A length ball, outside off. Sanju Samson hangs back, opens the face of the bat, and guides it towards third man for a boundary.
We are all set to begin! Ireland players are out there in the middle. Sanju Samson and Ishan Kishan are the openers for India. Mark Adair to start with the ball. Here we go...

So, the wait is over for the loyal Sanju Samson's fans. He is all set to play today and let's hope he makes this opportunity count! A lot of eyes will be on Ravi Bishnoi too as once India get back to the full-strength side, it will be interesting to see if India go with second leg-spinner along with Yuzvendra Chahal. A decent performance here would do wonders for him.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they would have bowled and he feels that it is good to chase in a T20 game. Tells that they have to do well with the ball to keep India to a low total. Mentions that they would try to match India as best as they can. Informs that it is Craig Young's 50th T20I and they were happy to give him a special cap and adds that they are playing the same team.

Hardik Pandya, the skipper of India, says that they will bat first, the wicket looks alright and the weather is awesome as well. Mentions that the last time they bowled they did not expect the wicket to do much but he credits the bowlers for the way they bowled. Informs that they have three changes, Ruturaj Gaikwad misses out because of a niggle and Sanju Samson replaces him, Harshal Patel in for Avesh Khan, and Ravi Bishnoi comes in for Yuzvendra Chahal.

Ireland (Unchanged Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Gareth Delany, Harry Tector, Lorcan Tucker (WK), George Dockrell, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Craig Young, Josh Little, Conor Olphert.

India (Playing XI) - Sanju Samson (In place of Ruturaj Gaikwad), Ishan Kishan (WK), Suryakumar Yadav, Hardik Pandya (C), Deepak Hooda, Dinesh Karthik, Axar Patel, Harshal Patel (In place of Avesh Khan), Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Ravi Bishnoi (In place of Yuzvendra Chahal), Umran Malik.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Hardik Pandya. India have elected to BAT first.

We witnessed a 12-over per-side game in the first T20I due to rain. Let’s hope our not-so-beloved friend stays away this time. The positive news is that the weather does seem better but we can never trust the weather here in Dublin. But let’s keep our fingers crossed. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
